hypothesis: The history shows the macro-balance hinge (c008) cut repair flips but raised crit_cross and lost score, while a pure cut-only backbone keeps crit_cross low; so keep the baseline cut/bin backbone and replace the hard 0.05 dead-band macro hinge with a soft, always-on but low-weight quadratic macro-balance term (no dead-band, no clamp) that gently steers macro count/area toward 50% without the aggressive flips that mangled structure.
analysis: All runs valid. Hypothesis partly held: repair flips fell (103→75, 238→212, 353→284) and C3 crit_cross dropped (0.069→0.002), but crit_cross rose sharply on C1/C2 (0.011→0.126, 0.000→0.120) and cut/wcut worsened on C2, driving score losses (C2 −0.263). Soft term still perturbs structure enough to create critical-pair crossings. Seed spread is unacceptable (std 0.337; C3 per-seed +0.37 to −0.62). Next: sweep the quadratic weight downward and add a crit_cross-aware penalty, validating per-seed stability before accepting.
